dict.string: Pin an app to the version you have now and updates can never move you off it. A pinned app stops offering updates, auto-update resolves to the pinned build, and even a manual Update reinstalls the pinned version. Unpin to go back to normal.
Pin state changes apply to the next update check — no respring. "Current version" comes from the App Store daemon's own ledger, so it is the exact build you are running.
